findings.quote: A solution of (R)-8-chloro-4-methyl-2-phenyl-2,3,4,5-tetrahydropyrido[3,2-f][1,4]oxazepine (83 mg, 0.30 mmol) and 6-methoxy-5-(4-methyl-1H-imidazol-1-yl)pyridin-2-amine (62.0 mg, 0.30 mmol) in DME (3 mL) was added to a microwave vial
findings.message: The source describes transferring a premixed solution into the preloaded reaction vial. Despite the uncertainty note, the operational steps place all three solution components directly in the reactor and omit the solution transfer. Represent the solution in a separate, unspecified preparation vessel and transfer it to the reactor.

value.evidence: A solution of (R)-8-chloro-4-methyl-2-phenyl-2,3,4,5-tetrahydropyrido[3,2-f][1,4]oxazepine (83 mg, 0.30 mmol) and 6-methoxy-5-(4-methyl-1H-imidazol-1-yl)pyridin-2-amine (62.0 mg, 0.30 mmol) in DME (3 mL) was added to a microwave vial
